items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: I was on the phone with Frank DeVito last night, my cousin who is a drummer from Utica... Frank, he was pretty good friends with him [Buddy Rich].

ctx.x: I talked to Frank DeVito last week and we were talking about him and it’s great man. I know he’s a wonderful player.
I had always hoped when he first went to New York that I could hook him up with you.
